Why do people follow the success books and still get no results?

Kevin Trudeau says there are three reasons people fail, and the first is that they don't apply the manifesting formula properly.

The books say to define your dream, build a burning desire and feel as if you already have it. Kevin explains that Norman Vincent Peale called this the as-if principle, and Napoleon Hill wrote about it too.

Yet when people do exactly that, they often don't get results. Kevin's point is that the recipe has missing ingredients.

Which part of that formula do you find hardest to do?
